name: 22408 · Fredericksbrg, VA
findings: ZIP 22408 (Fredericksbrg) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22408 (Fredericksbrg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22408 (Fredericksbrg) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
